programs.title: Summer Camp
programs.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programs.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programs.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.

programs.title: Rooster
programs.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.
